questions.question: What sin did Israel commit at Peor?
options: Worshiping Baal and immorality with Moab
Murdering one of the chief tribal leaders
Lying about the report of the spies
Stealing gold dedicated to the LORD
questions.answer: Worshiping Baal and immorality with Moab

questions.question: Who stopped the plague by his zealous action?
A plague struck Israel because of their sin at Peor.
Israel joined themselves to _____ of Peor, and the LORD's anger burned.
_____, son of Eleazar, turned away God's wrath by his zeal.
